save_cluster_assignment: save cluster assignments to a torch file in the specified output directory
load_cluster_assignment: load cluster assignments from a previously saved torch file
save_cluster_assignment_as_dataset: export cluster assignments as numpy image paths and labels files per split
visualize_cluster_images: visualize a random subset of images assigned to a specific cluster in a grid
map_cluster_to_images: build a mapping from cluster IDs to lists of image indices
